skill.name: skill-authoring
skill.description: Agent Skills の skill、つまり `SKILL.md` とそのディレクトリを作る・直す・添削するときに読む。本文を skill が必要な理由と達成したい状態から導いて書き、直すときも全体を導き直す。
skill.summary: Create and revise Agent Skills from user decisions, with clear rules, organized procedures, and validation guidance.
skill.author: masseater

security_audit.summary: All 23 static findings are false positives: Markdown backticks, reference URLs, and readable Japanese prose explain the detections. No evidence found of prompt injection, secret collection, data exfiltration, or obfuscated payloads in the three reviewed files. The creation workflow uses external initialization and validation tools and follows repository pull request procedures.

static_findings.snippet: description: Agent Skills の skill、つまり `SKILL.md` とそのディレクトリを作る・直す・添削するときに読む。本文を skill が必要な理由と達成したい状態か
- `SKILL.md` には、説明である必要な理由と達成したい状態と、参照である規則を置く
- 手順は `usecases/` に置く。見出しは「〜するとき」ではなく「〜する」の動詞句にする
- 特定のリポジトリや環境に固有の参照は `references/` に置く
- 関係するセクションの先頭に「[`name`](references/name.md) も読むこと」と書く
- `name` はディレクトリ名と同じにする。本文の最初の見出しも同じ名前にする
- `description` には何をするかと、いつ使うかを書く。使う場面の語を入れる
- `description` に本文の目次を書かない。`references/` や `usecases/` が増えるたびに直すことになる
- `license` は書かない。LICENSE ファイルも作らない
`metadata.derived-from` には、この skill の原典の URL だけを書く。原典とは、その内容を取り込み、読み替えてこの skill にしたものである。skill でも記事で
- 原典の URL、作者、バージョンは本文と `references/` に書かない
`metadata` の値は文字列だけなので、複数の URL は空白区切りの 1 つの文字列にする。
```yaml
- [`create`](usecases/create.md)。skill を作る
derived-from: https://github.com/cursor/plugins/blob/bebaffe14f8f442b98e9c409e960aedad59b5fc8/pstack
- 構成と frontmatter は https://agentskills.io/specification に従う
- 読み手の model 向けの書き方は https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-engineering/claude
https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/blob/<commit>/path/SKILL.md
https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/tree/<commit>/path/another-skill

content.value_statement: AI-written skills can introduce assumptions that users never approved. This skill guides creation and revision from user decisions, explicit goals, and organized rules.
actual_capabilities: Guide skill creation from the underlying problem and desired outcome.
Separate core rules, use case procedures, and environment-specific references.
Draft frontmatter descriptions and commit-pinned source provenance metadata.
Revise related rules consistently after user feedback while preserving unchanged sections.
Guide initialization, structural validation, reference checks, and applicable test cases.
Summarize the skill, design decisions, and validation results after creation.
limitations: The bundled instructions are written in Japanese.
Initialization and validation require external skills and skills-ref command-line tools that are not bundled.
Several writing and reasoning conventions depend on named companion skills that are not included.
Structural validation does not guarantee model behavior; the workflow omits test cases for subjective content.

use_cases.title: Create a Team Workflow Skill
use_cases.description: Turn a recurring engineering workflow into clear rules, separate procedures, and explicit validation steps.

use_cases.title: Revise Skills After Feedback
use_cases.description: Identify the decision behind feedback and update every affected rule without rewriting sections that remain correct.

use_cases.title: Organize Skill Documentation
use_cases.description: Review frontmatter, reference placement, and source attribution to make a skill easier to maintain.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a First Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me create a skill for [task]. The problem is [problem], and the desired outcome is [outcome]. Ask about decisions that change its purpose.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: define the purpose and draft initial rules.

prompt_templates.title: Review an Existing Skill
prompt_templates.prompt: Review [skill directory] against these authoring rules. Identify unsupported assumptions, misplaced procedures, unclear descriptions, and broken references. Propose changes for my review.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect an existing skill before editing.

prompt_templates.title: Apply Feedback Consistently
prompt_templates.prompt: Revise [skill directory] using this feedback: [feedback]. Identify the underlying decision, update all affected rules, and preserve sections that remain correct.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: revise the whole design after a user correction.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a Validated Skill Change
prompt_templates.prompt: Prepare [skill directory] for repository review. Check structure, frontmatter, provenance, referenced files, and companion skills. Run available validation and applicable tests. Report blockers honestly.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: verify a skill change before a pull request.

output_examples.input: Create a skill for reviewing database migrations using our approved review policy.
output: Draft purpose: preserve the review decisions in the supplied policy without adding unapproved requirements.
Organization: keep shared rules in the main skill document and the review procedure in a separate use case document.
Verification plan: validate structure, check referenced files, and test objective rules with representative migration cases.

output_examples.input: Our skill repeats the same rule in several sections. Revise it without changing its meaning.
output: Design decision: express the shared rule once and reference its authoritative location.
Revision scope: update every affected section while preserving unrelated wording.
Review summary: identify the consolidated rule and explain how the revised structure preserves the original decision.

best_practices: Provide the underlying problem, desired outcome, and decisions the skill must preserve.
Verify referenced files and companion skills before treating the workflow as complete.
Validate structure and test objective rules against representative cases before repository review.
anti_patterns: Fill missing user decisions with generic advice or unapproved assumptions.
Append isolated corrections without checking other rules affected by the same reasoning.
Duplicate source information and shared rules across multiple documents.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It guides creation, review, and revision of Agent Skills, including their main document, procedures, frontmatter, and references.

faq.question: Does it include executable scripts?
faq.answer: No. The package contains three Markdown files. Its creation procedure references external initialization and validation commands.

faq.question: Which tools are listed as supported?
faq.answer: The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code. The package does not include compatibility test results.

faq.question: Can I use it without companion skills?
faq.answer: Core guidance is readable independently, but several conventions delegate to writing, humanity-and-humanness, and poteto-principles, which are not bundled.

faq.question: How does it handle user feedback?
faq.answer: It identifies the decision behind the feedback, revisits the overall design, updates related rules, and preserves unchanged sections.

faq.question: Does validation guarantee correct behavior?
faq.answer: No. The workflow calls for structural validation, reference checks, and tests for structural content. These checks do not guarantee future model behavior.
